critical_code_review_comments: MarkerStudio.jsx continues to grow (now includes RosterOverlay + RosterTile + runRosterScan + pickRosterPlayer on top of the iter18 multi-anchor logic). The file likely exceeds 1500 lines now — strongly recommend splitting into sub-modules per the iter18 review (anchor-strip, roster-scan hook, MediaPipe loader, gesture controller, geometry helpers).

verify_and_pick_thumbnail in precision_engine.py is well-tested (3 tests cover: missing video, picks correct frame matching fingerprint, falls back when no match). Returns (ok, meta) tuple — clean contract.

Public /api/sample/scoutmeplay-report.pdf endpoint correctly serves the most recent paid report's PDF without auth — appropriate for marketing CTA. Consider adding HTTP cache headers (Cache-Control max-age=3600) to reduce server load on the public endpoint.
Empty-state UX is clean: when roster scan finds 0 candidates the user gets a clear message + Try Again + manual fallback. Good defensive design.

ms-anchor-strip and ms-done-fullwidth are correctly conditionally rendered only when anchors.length > 0 — this means a freshly switched MANUAL mode (via ms-roster-manual) does NOT show those testids until the user adds the first anchor. Reasonable UX, but the review request implies ms-done-fullwidth should be visible after tile-tap (which auto-locks anchor 1) — that specific path could not be E2E tested because the synthetic plain-green clip yields 0 roster candidates. Once any anchor exists (verified via manual draw + add), both testids appear correctly.
